messages.subject: multimodal posterior?
parts:
Hi,

I have problem on interpreting a trace (attached).  Can somebody help?  It looks there may be two posterior modes and stan is switching between them.  Is this correct or there is another explanation?  The model is attached.  Note that there are more parameters than data points.

Than

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] multimodal posterior?
parts:
I agree that's what it looks like. Looks like your
message cut out. What do the other parameters look like?
A pairs() plot may help you see what's going on --- often
two parameters will both jump together.

Having more parameters than data points isn't necessarily
an issue if you have priors that weakly identify the model.

- Bob
